dataset.name: Very-young Korean ER-positive breast cancer (ICGC BRCA-KR)
dataset.description: Independent Korean early-onset ER-positive breast-cancer cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Women diagnosed before age 35 with ER-positive primary breast cancer. TRACE Explorer restricts the release to invasive ductal carcinoma or adenocarcinoma and excludes ductal carcinoma in situ and tumors with ambiguous histology.
dataset.publication_citation: ICGC BRCA-KR and EGA EGAS00001001908 project record

metadata.source_project: Breast Cancer - Very young women, Korea
metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TRACE Explorer requires an endpoint-complete donor and an open GAF/RSEM RNA-seq analysis linked to a primary solid tumor explicitly annotated as invasive ductal carcinoma or adenocarcinoma. One analysis is selected deterministically per donor.

expression.label: log2(RSEM normalized expression + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The ICGC adapter applies source.duplicate_gene_policy before this matrix is materialized. BRCA-KR repeats SLC35E2 without a disambiguating source identifier, so all occurrences of that symbol are removed rather than aggregated; the matrix supplied to the generic builder is unique.
expression.scale_note: ICGC identifies the normalization algorithm as RSEM but does not encode a more specific denominator for normalized_read_count in the project rows. TRACE Explorer removes the one repeated source symbol rather than aggregating it, preserves the remaining supplied non-negative scale, applies log2(value + 1) once and restricts interpretation to within-cohort relative expression.
